commercialPurpose: Show beverage selections, expert picks, pricing, and product benefits without a sterile ecommerce grid.
purposeLayer: Commerce grid lets visitors browse product flavors while seeing proof, picks, and benefit modules.
anatomyLayer: Featured drink/product image, smaller product thumbnails, expert pick copy, price module, carousel controls, benefit card rows, and CTA band.
hierarchyLayer: Featured product first, price/action second, benefit cards third.
gridRhythmLayer: Product showcase flow with one featured beverage block, adjacent thumbnails, price CTA, and supporting benefit grid.
originalityLayer: Extract section grammar only; do not copy exact artwork, imagery, spacing, copy, color identity, brand marks, product photos, or page order.
usageRuleLayer: Use for product-focused templates that need a premium browse-and-buy section rather than equal product tiles.
layoutGesture: beverage commerce grid with featured product and benefit cards
sectionSilhouette: light page section mixing large drink image, small flavor thumbnails, price/action card, and lower feature cards
compositionTension: product desirability is balanced with purchase clarity and benefit reassurance
focalPath: featured drink to price card to thumbnails to benefit grid
negativeSpaceShape: white spacing separates sensory product blocks from structured commerce cards
depthLayering: product photo layer, thumbnail cards, price chip, benefit card row, CTA stripe
moduleScaleVariation: one large product visual with small thumbnails and compact feature cards
breakoutBehavior: featured product block spans more space than standard commerce cards
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact drink photos, prices, orange CTA strip, or flavor thumbnails.
